proof.GATE_2_CALIBRATION.calibration_populatio: the second pass's retention (spaced by role for spectrum families, caliper-likely for local families, class and near-form arms), not §12.7's tier budget; pooled over frames as a measurement budget (V8_FRAME_CONDITIONING.md §5); every forwarded rung is calibrated on every block of every calibration pass, hence under every frame on the whole allocation

REGIME_SCREEN.frame_conditioning.at_this_stage: pooled over the four frames as a measurement budget: at 24 topics x 1 draw a frame holds six topics; the screen decides which rungs are measured at calibration and every measured rung is calibrated under every frame; no admission, matching or selection reads a screen quantity (§12.2; docs/V8_FRAME_CONDITIONING.md §5)

SECOND_PASS_SCREEN.frame_conditioning.at_this_stage: pooled over the four frames as a measurement budget (six topics per frame per batch): the forwarded set is what calibration measures, on every block and hence under every frame; eligibility, matching and selection are decided per frame at Gates 2 and 3 on calibration rows only (docs/V8_FRAME_CONDITIONING.md §5)

reading: the screen's difficulty table carries no frame column and a single scalar iota_a_prescreen, so the ranking coordinate and the retention target are one number for all four frames
the retention config carries only budget sizes (spectrum_rungs, local_rungs, family caps): no frame appears in the rule
Gate 2 then holds a different iota_A for each frame, which is the coordinate every later caliper is measured against

calibration.note: supported frames only; a frame Gate 2 did not support has no iota_A(f) and no table

noise.statement: at 24 pre-screen topics x 1 draw a frame holds six topics, so a frame's screen iota moves in steps of about 1/6 before the chance correction; the median SE below is on the same scale as (or larger than) the 0.10 caliper, and that imprecision is the reason the screen was pooled in the first place

matched_controls.why: no operating point: Gate 2 did not support this frame, so there is no iota_A(f) to match against and no screen-near count is defined

matched_controls.reading: the first count is the matched controls the frozen pipeline actually put in hand on this frame; the screen-near counts are candidates that were never calibrated, so their validity is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE and none of them is credited with an outcome here

calibration_allocation.amendment: CHANGES_SCIENTIFIC.md 2026-08-30 (two passes, 96 topics per frame; prompted by r5/r6's measured per-frame SE(iota) = 0.0497 against the unchanged 0.05 floor) and 2026-08-31 (four passes for qwen3-4b, 192 topics per frame at the topic ceiling; prompted by r8's split-level V_coord refusals under §13.7 condition 1). No threshold moved at either step.
calibration_allocation.rule: a calibration pass renders every calibration topic under one frame; pass p offsets the frame by frame_offsets[p]. The offsets are distinct modulo N_WORDINGS, so every frame is measured on passes/N_WORDINGS of the calibration topics, no topic recurs within a frame, and each frame's own information grows with the pass count at proportional Gate-2 generation. No frame is pooled with another (rules.calibration_frame_offsets)
